about.title: About the PD1 Promos
paragraphs: PD1 Promos lists the 19 Disney Lorcana promo cards numbered 1/PD1 to 19/PD1, from products and promotions and books.

They come from Products and promotions, Attack of the Vine! Prerelease Pack, Hyperia City Prerelease Pack, ’Quest of Wonders: An Illumineer’s Lorebook’ and ’Illumineer’s Quest: The Great Hunny Rescue’ victory card.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
